params.name: page[limit]
params.description: Maximum number of clients to return

params.name: page[offset]
params.description: Number of entries to skip for pagination

params.name: filter
params.description: OData-style filter expression. Supported fields include hostName and hostType. Example: hostType eq 'CLIENT'

items.docs: Returns a list of hosts registered with the NetBackup primary server, including backup clients, media servers, and other host types. Results can be filtered by host name and host type.

params.name: hostId
params.description: The unique identifier or hostname of the client

items.docs: Retrieves detailed configuration and status information for a specific NetBackup host including operating system details, hardware platform, and connectivity status.
